recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆大細胞含四個彼此分開、大小一致的卵圓形細胞核，細胞質豐富、淡紫藍色帶細小紫紅顆粒且邊緣不規則，是蝕骨細胞（osteoclast）的典型樣子。
features: Large multinucleated cell, many times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Four discrete, uniform oval nuclei with evenly dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous small nucleoli
Abundant pale blue-lilac cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and irregular, frayed cell borders
Nuclei are separate and not connected, unlike a lobulated megakaryocyte nucleus
Background of normocytic red cells and scattered platelets
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large multinucleated cell with four separate, evenly sized oval nuclei with fine chromatin and abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules. The cell borders are irregular. The nuclei are discrete and uniform rather than a single lobulated nucleus. Findings are consistent with an osteoclast.

ddx.vs: A megakaryocyte has one large multilobated nucleus with interconnected lobes and granular cytoplasm often shedding platelets, not multiple separate uniform nuclei.
Osteoblasts are individual mononuclear cells with eccentric nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and a perinuclear clear zone distant from the nucleus.

ddx.dx: Multinucleated plasma cell or tumor giant cell
ddx.vs: Neoplastic multinucleated cells show nuclear pleomorphism, variable nuclear size, and prominent nucleoli, whereas osteoclast nuclei are uniform and bland.
